_meta.note: Walking-logic extracted from TibiaWiki 'Route:Edron Bog Raider Cave' text + 6-panel annotated maze map (Bograidercave.gif). Tibia 7.4 vanilla; verify on Rivalia. This is a dungeon-descent route from the Edron surface down into the Bog Raider cave.
_meta.coord_system: Tibia game coords. z = floor (7=ground surface, higher=deeper underground). down = descend one floor.
_meta.legend: steps[] follow the 6 map panels of Bograidercave.gif in reading order (top-left → top-right, then bottom-left → bottom-right). Each panel is a successive underground floor of the maze; the red/marked corridor is the path. The last panel is the cave entrance proper.

start.note: Surface hole; text minimap coords 130.22 / 124.43 / z7. Bring a Rope to climb back out.

min_level_note: Bog Raiders hit hard for their tier — mid-level+ recommended; go with sustain (mana/health) for the descent maze.

steps.text: On the Edron surface, use/go DOWN the hole at ~130.22 124.43 (z7). This drops you into the first cave level (top-left panel).

steps.heading: follow corridor
steps.text: Panel 1 (top-left): follow the winding marked corridor through the first underground chamber to the next hole/descent.
Panel 2 (top-middle): take the branching corridor to the descent point that drops to the next level.

steps.heading: spiral
steps.text: Panel 3 (top-right): follow the spiral/coiled passage around to its inner descent.
Panel 4 (bottom-left): a long snaking corridor — walk it end-to-end to the next hole.
Panel 5 (bottom-middle): short oval chamber with the final descent hole in the middle.

steps.heading: follow corridor
steps.text: Panel 6 (bottom-right): the long marked corridor here is the BEGINNING of the Bog Raider Cave proper — the hunting ground. Green markers along it indicate the spawn zone.

return_shortcut.text: No shortcut given — climb back up the same descent chain with a Rope, or use a return teleport/logout if the cave has one. Retrace the panel maze in reverse.
